en: a lens (= a curved piece of glass), usually with a handle, that you look through and that makes things look bigger than they really are
ex: He examined the stamp under a powerful magnifying glass.
他在有力的放大镜下检查了邮票。

en: the great size or importance of something; the degree to which something is large or important
ex: We did not realize the magnitude of the problem.
我们没有意识到这个问题的重要性。

en: a tree with large white, pink or purple flowers that smell sweet

zh: （容量为 1.5 升的）大酒瓶，大瓶
en: a bottle containing 1.5 litres of wine, etc.
ex: a magnum of champagne
一瓶1.5升的香槟

en: a large and important work of art, literature or music, especially one that people think is the best work ever produced by that artist, writer, etc.
ex: The author produced his magnum opus just before he died.
作者在临死前就创作了他的作品。

zh: (1929-2007) a British broadcaster, writer and journalist, born of Icelandic parents. He presented the television quiz show Mastermind for 25 years (1972-97). He also presented several other television programmes and wrote books on historical subjects.
